description: Prepare a checkin and return a short-lived confirmation token. Without paths it takes ALL tracked pending changes in the workspace; with paths only the changes at or below those paths, plus the Unity .meta partner of every selected asset. Private files are never included, except a new parent folder that a selected item needs (listed in dependencies). Review the returned changes with the user before confirming.

paths.description: Optional files or directories relative to UVCS_WORKSPACE to check in instead of every pending change.

name: uvcs_checkin_prepare
